text:
Sam (marketing): Quick ask 3 - can eng/runtime produce a compact bench snapshot for the launch demo next Tue? Need numbers we can confidently show in slides and a tiny repro bundle for press.

Sam (marketing): Items we need: p50/p95/p99 token latencies, tokens/sec throughput, cold vs warm wall times, FP16 baseline + one quantized variant (int8). Raw CSV histograms and the seed list.

Daniel (eng-runtime): Happy to run a focused smoke. Clarify: which model + sequence length? single-user interactive numbers or a small concurrency curve? Server-side timings or full end-to-end app latency too?

Sam (marketing): Model: redwood-2-small (demo config). Context 1024. Typical demo turn ~20 tokens. We want: single-session interactive p95 for slides, plus a 5-user throughput datapoint for claims. Server-side token timings + an end-to-end coldstart datapoint.

Priya (eng-runtime): Plan: FP16 run, q4f16/int8 run. Do 3 full cold restarts to capture coldstart variance. Warm runs: 10k tokens each with continuous batching OFF to simulate single-session pacing. Capture token timing, KV cache hit rate, GPU power trace.

Priya (eng-runtime): Repro command (to be checked into the artefact):
```bash
./bench_run.sh --model redwood-2-small --context 1024 --mode single-session --tokens 10000 --quant fp16 --dump-trace \
  && ./bench_run.sh --model redwood-2-small --context 1024 --mode single-session --tokens 10000 --quant int8 --dump-trace --repeats 3
```
Include --dump-trace to upload raw traces to s3.

Daniel (eng-runtime): We'll also record exact provenance: docker tag, commit sha, CUDA/cuDNN versions, kernel commit, quant recipe id. Those go into a manifest for legal/comms.

Riya (marketing): Deliverable expectations from marketing POV: 1) one-page summary (numbers + bullets on methodology), 2) histograms CSV, 3) repro script (bench_run.sh), 4) seeds and sample payloads, 5) README with exact commands.

Priya (eng-runtime): Upload target: s3://redwood-marketing/bench-snaps/3609991111-launch-snapshot/ containing summary.pdf, histograms.csv, repro.sh, seeds.txt, manifest.json, raw-traces.tar.gz. Will include CI job link and run logs. ETA ~24h.

Daniel (eng-runtime): Do you want token-position heatmaps (start vs mid vs tail)? p95 varies with prompt position; useful for webinar narrative.

Sam (marketing): Yes please. Split by prompt length buckets: short <32, medium 32-128, long 128-1024. We'll reference those in the slides.

BenchBot: Upload started to s3://redwood-marketing/bench-snaps/3609991111-launch-snapshot/ (progress 0%). Will post final link when complete.

Daniel (eng-runtime): One last note: marketing should approve exact claim text before publishing (e.g., "p95 latency X ms for interactive chat (single-session, warmed, ctx=1024)"). We need the condition clauses to avoid compliance flags.

Riya (marketing): Will draft claim language and share here. Avoid absolute coldstart claims.

Sam (marketing): Thanks! Tag me when artifacts are up and I'll pull the summary for comms. :thumbsup:
